size_semantics: square/triangle/star use canonical target_at side; circle uses side as diameter; record the actual support bounding box and area per cell

carrier.rationale: period 48 is within 1.5x of both models' measured ramp ranges, so neither extrapolates hard; order separation 403 px vs 151 px in the 2026-10-27 round; the fresh capture refits both models on the current path

placement_check.note: dominant terms agree to 0.7% / 6.5%; cross terms differ by 2 px and 35 px absolute; the session refits on the current path

exposure.replay_ladder_rationale: the 2026-10-27 round settled at 431-716 ms with peak 4095 on every recorded frame (saturated); a 300 ms ceiling stays below that measured saturation point while spanning 20x down to a bias-dominated point

sessions.name: s1200
sessions.model: fresh (capture 12 probes at grid 384, fit 150 iterations, then geometry_wide at grid 640)
sessions.purpose: train the physical model on the current path and shape the four largest targets

sessions.name: s600
sessions.model: reuse s1200 (--model-dir), including model640 and model_wide640
sessions.purpose: same model, same carrier, smaller target

sessions.name: s200
sessions.purpose: same model, same carrier, smallest target

reference_probe.when: before s1200, between s1200/s600 and between s600/s200
reference_probe.what: plane phase at 5 and 12 ms, 8-bit, zero-order centroid and peak
reference_probe.why: the model and zero_xy are reused across sessions, so bench drift between sessions must be measured rather than assumed

criteria.geometry: every target box fully inside the camera window and the window inside the sensor, else the runner raises (validate.py:114, :229); no silent crop or rescale
criteria.saturation: a cell is rejected if its core peak reaches 250/255 of full scale during shaping (validate.py:254); each replay point is audited on raw_frames.max() and dropped if saturated
criteria.exposure_bias: at least three unsaturated replay points, and the lowest point must be within a factor 3 of the estimated additive bias so the bias is identifiable
criteria.stage_acceptance: stages 2-4 accept on core CV only; a stage that does not improve keeps the previous phase
criteria.comparability: identical carrier period, zero_radius, stage recipes and target semantics across the three sizes; only side and window_span vary
criteria.failure_is_a_result: a cell whose target leaves the sensor, whose core saturates, or whose stage CV does not improve is reported as such, not dropped

deferred: seed replication (three probe-family seeds) on the full matrix; this round uses one seed and documents the limitation
interleaving shapes across sizes; the runner fixes one side per invocation, so sizes run as three consecutive sessions
GS initial phase (gs_calls_allowed = 0 in the source plan); the bake-off is limited to transport / backprojection
WFS and DM channels (devices not connected)
